text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The combination of double vision that may worsen with gaze, progressive weakness in the upper limbs and shoulders, and potential difficulty swallowing (dysphagia) is highly characteristic of Myasthenia Gravis. The pending Acetylcholine Receptor Antibody test and Creatine Kinase levels will help confirm this diagnosis and rule out other neuromuscular disorders.
